name: gpss-patent
description: Global patent search through the Taiwan IPO GPSS API (TW, US, JP, EP, KR, CN, WO and more): an MCP server plus a search-workflow skill.

interface.shortDescription: Search TW/US/JP/EP/KR/CN/WO patents through TIPO GPSS.
interface.longDescription: Read-only patent search over the Taiwan IPO Global Patent Search System API: Boolean field queries, CPC/IPC/FI classification, applicant and inventor filters, date ranges, and abstracts and claims. Requires a GPSS API userCode (review takes 1-3 working days); GPSS blocks mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau.
defaultPrompt: Search Taiwan and US patents for lameness detection in dairy cows and list the most relevant ones.
Find patents whose CPC is H04W and applicant is Acme, published 2022 to 2024.
Fetch the abstract and claims of a patent from its publication number.
